method.confidence_filter: VIIRS nominal/high; MODIS >= 30; type=0 if present
method.coverage_rule: Detection presence is not verified observation coverage; no missing day is imputed as zero.
method.action_window_status: unavailable: complete weekly observation coverage not established
limitations: Detection-only files cannot distinguish a true zero from missing sensor coverage.
Hotspots are satellite flagged pixels, not individual fires or burned area.
Clouds, smoke, overpass timing and instrument differences affect observations.
Region bounds are a rectangle, not an exact state polygon.
Action window is withheld pending independent coverage verification.
method.map_geometry: spherical sinusoidal grid cell polygons (approximate; no state polygon clipping)
method.spatial_expansion_rule: two consecutive daily increases in active cell count
method.nrt_caveat: 2026 VIIRS Aug–Oct and MODIS Sep–Oct are NRT and may be revised; 2026-10 is last included month.

meta.source: NASA FIRMS/LANCE MODIS Collection 6.1 and VIIRS Suomi-NPP Collection 2, standard archive and near-real-time (NRT)
